# Autodesk Model Derivative (translate and export designs)

`autodesk-aps-model-derivative` · openapi · version `2.0` · **drafts** · readiness `discovered`

Autodesk Platform Services Model Derivative API: translate designs (Fusion, Inventor, Revit and others) to other formats, and read their metadata, properties and thumbnails.
